setting: Keep actual November DiffV2IR pixels, frozen original detector weights, splits, normalization and original direct RGB baseline29.529. No image regeneration or Test fitting.
hypothesis: Generated IR is unreliable for fine identity texture but can provide coarse figure-ground support. Use it to allocate high-resolution RGB detection crops, tolerating local cross-modal geometry distortions. Compare complete equal-budget RGB saliency and uniform crops; do not credit ordinary test-time augmentation alone.
saliency: Current-frame robust distance from background median in scalar new IR or RGB Lab channels; normalize with robust channel MAD and the95th percentile. Add the same RGB weak/small-proposal density to both selectors. Subtract75% saliency inside already confident whole-image detections, leaving localization support. Greedy fixed-size integral-window mass coverage, suppress selected window mass before the next crop. No labels or future frames.
controls: Zero extra crop: exact original detection cache
RGB-only adaptive crops, same RGB crop detector and count
Actual new-IR adaptive crops, same RGB crop detector and count
Both original RGB and frozen paired new-IR global detection streams
fusion: Two registered forms: same one-to-one cross-view clustering with confidence-weighted resolution^2 box refinement; and plain concatenation/NMS removal control. No within-view clustering of distinct predictions. Preserve original global confidence maxima; unmatched ROI detections require score>=0.6 and must be interior to non-image crop boundaries.
tracker: First complete Dev screen uses unchanged original ByteTrack; promising fixed detector streams then receive the same stronger causal RGB/multimodal backend, with proper controls.
Test_policy: No new Test inference until complete Dev selection and matched controls are frozen.
storage: Numerical proposal caches only, no image dataset copies, no model upload; independent work disk64GiB soft cap and40GiB reserve.
attention_RGB_prior: Use the common frozen RGB-global proposal stream for both cue selectors and both global detection frontends. The primary late-fusion RGB-global method has exact equal crop count/model/compute to its RGB-guided counterpart. The paired-V3-global variant additionally uses that shared RGB attention prior and must report its extra global detector cost.
empty_IR_policy: If the current new-IR frame is spatially flat, fall back exactly to RGB attention; no synthetic evidence.
weight_read_amendment: Before any crop forward or accuracy result: prefer the existing compact FP16 EMA checkpoint selected at joint3, exactly the baseline Test inference checkpoint. Original full1.19GB cold-NAS checkpoint loading was canceled; no model/optimizer retraining or data/threshold change.
window_tie_break: Before any crop forward: among equal maximal integral-mass windows, prefer minimal distance between window center and its evidence centroid, avoiding arbitrary border clipping. Empty attention falls back to uncovered uniform windows.
geometry_only_pilot_amendment: Before any Dev accuracy result: first8-frame geometry-only pilot shows four half-image attention windows can equal the complete uniform cover, making the four-crop attention intervention uninformative. Register both half and quarter scales for both cue selectors, same crop counts/models and uniform-half control. Complete the previously registered weak/small RGB proposal prior: even confident boxes smaller than64 network pixels receive localization support. Bounded two-frame image prefetch is consumed strictly by current timestamp; no cross-frame model input.
current_forward_inputs: Each detector eval forward sees only RGB crops from the current frame. Current IR determines only current attention. No future pixels enter a prediction.
